messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High tail latency spike for tenant 'sirocco' in dedicated-pool-12. Error rate up ~5% over baseline. Pager: harper
harper (oncall): on it. checking logs + metrics. assigning eng-runtime
mia (eng-runtime): reading traces, KV cache hit rate dropped, queue depth spiking on pool-12, looks tenant-local. any recent deploys to Sirocco? @kyle
kyle (acct-exec): no deploys from client side, they reported timeouts via support 2m ago
sachin (support): saw 504s from s3 gateway retries, forwarded customer screenshot. link: https://sirocco-cust.example.com/error
aj (eng-sre): tagging in. what's current max_batch_tokens for their bespoke scheduler? could be causing long batch formation during bursts
harper (oncall): current knob read: max_batch_tokens=4096, scheduler.weight=1.2 for tenant-sirocco in pool-12
mia (eng-runtime): that max looks high given their bursty short-request profile. suggest temporary mitigation: reduce max_batch_tokens to 512 and lower scheduler.window_ms to 40ms
aj (eng-sre): agree. plan: 1) set per-tenant max_batch_tokens=512 2) set scheduler.window_ms=40 for tenant-sirocco 3) enable short-circuit fallback to model-small if queue depth > 200
harper (oncall): can we do the change without a restart? we have hot-config via control-plane
mia (eng-runtime): yes, use runtimectl patch-tenant-config. command:
``
runtimectl patch-tenant-config --tenant sirocco --pool dedicated-pool-12 --set max_batch_tokens=512 --set scheduler.window_ms=40
```
deploy-bot: rolling config apply started (patch id: cfg-9832) — 6 nodes targeted
metrics-bot: alert -> tail_p95 latency for tenant-sirocco jumped from 240ms -> 2.1s at 1768881220
harper (oncall): applying now.
aj (eng-sre): also putting rate-limit soft cap for their API key to 300 rps as emergency guard
kyle (acct-exec): I'll notify the customer about temporary degradation and throttling, and say we're applying mitigations
sachin (support): customer acknowledges, says they're OK with brief throttling if it stabilizes
deploy-bot: config apply finished on 6/6 nodes (cfg-9832) at 1768881452
metrics-bot: post-change metrics: queue depth halved, tail_p95 dropped to ~420ms, error rate back to baseline
mia (eng-runtime): looking good. follow-up: we should schedule a bespoke profiling session with Sirocco to adjust quantization/seq-length tuning; current model variant may be inefficient for their request distribution
aj (eng-sre): created follow-up ticket INF-4721: long-term bespoke tuning + canary test for smaller model variant. assigning to mia + harper
harper (oncall): handing off to eng-runtime for post-mortem & client outreach. oncall out
mia (eng-runtime): will do post-mortem and coordinate with account. grabbing logs + flamegraphs
kyle (acct-exec): thanks team. I'll update the customer in 10m with timeline and next steps :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident closed (mitigated) at 1768881899 — root cause: tenant-specific batching configuration too permissive for bursty short requests. recommendation: adjust defaults for dedicated pools and add adaptive max_batch_tokens heuristic
